text: I would think it is much, much less of a risk for non-family members - PIBA sees parents as particularly risky and likely to settle. But a family? I think it is likely to be okay. In my view, the thing that is more likely to raise the risk is that they are Ukrainian - they should definitely have return tickets, be able to explain what they intend to do while here, and perhaps bring evidence of their ties back in Germany.
